Built a complete, playable 3D mobile-friendly game in `index.html`.

**Starlight Rescue** is a non-violent rescue game: aim at the glowing enchanted tethers and tap to free the sky courier before the rescue signal runs out. Each mission adds more tethers and speeds up the timer. Supports touch, mouse, the on-screen **RESCUE** button, and **Space**.

I used safety tethers rather than a choking or hanging depiction. Verified the game loads, a tether can be released to complete a rescue, and the next mission starts with an increased level.
